dedupe_keys.name: shafts building height and footprint extraction package

description: SHAFTS is a Python package developed to extract building height and footprint from Sentinel imagery. It prepares Sentinel-1 radar, Sentinel-2 optical and optional SRTM elevation inputs, then applies trained deep-learning models. Example scripts support individual regions and batches, with documented models at several grid resolutions. The reference dataset covers 46 cities, while new areas and years require suitable imagery and model weights. These building attributes can prepare exposure and urban morphology inputs for infrastructure-risk and heat simulations. GitHub and PyPI distribute the package; PyPI explicitly states GPL v3, so the software is free under that licence despite missing GitHub licence metadata. Local prediction and Google Earth Engine or Google Cloud workflows are documented separately; cloud services require their own accounts and may incur costs. A limitation is transfer to cities unlike the training data and dependence on pretrained weights. The README reports testing on Linux and macOS but does not establish equivalent Windows testing. No directly related catalogue record was established. No imagery or model weights were downloaded.
name: SHAFTS building-height and footprint extraction package
